name: pilotix
description: Pilotix — order management for cash-on-delivery e-commerce in Algeria (web, Android, iOS)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pilotix/shared && npm run build -w @pilotix/core && npm run build -w @pilotix/server && npm run build -w @pilotix/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @pilotix/shared && npm run build -w @pilotix/core && npm test -w @pilotix/core
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pilotix/shared && npm run build -w @pilotix/core && npm run typecheck -w @pilotix/server && npm run typecheck -w @pilotix/web
